notes.title: Art update: new buildings for mole vilage.
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We a working on filling the world of our game. We are created a mole vilage with cute dwellers and a lot of buildings with different functiones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/400ccd4ad89b9ea73469b76164cb389ba2efedee.png[/img]
Alchemist factory for example. In this building you can create a new poisons and cooking some dishes. It help you to improove your characteristic in fight. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/6d8a1836e29614d19236810751f787e17c89f51f.png[/img]
In energy bank you can create a new battaries for your guns. And replenish supplies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/09f01bbf5e42416de375409011166a431589356d.png[/img]
In vilage you can find a gun shop and ammo shop, caterpillar factory and another interesting buildings. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019077/e9a85d20011b4341957bd79271d8eeba0f9ae138.png[/img]
